description.text: Why this university? Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST) is a key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the P.R.China. The university, which is one of the largest in China, is distinctive among institutions of higher education. It covers a set of disciplines: philosophy, economics, law, education, literature, history, agriculture, science, engineering, medicine and management. ProgramIntroduction Industrial Economics involves the study of theoretical and applied microeconomics, with a particular focus on the modern business enterprise and its operating environment. FeeStructure 1.Tuition Fee: 38000 RMB/year 2.Accommodation Fee: Please click here to see details 3.Living Cost:15000~20000 RMB/year 4.Insurance: 600 RMB/year 5.Others(books,deposit): 2000 RMB/year Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Duration:2 Years Degree Awarded Master 's degree of Economic FutureCareer The degree provides its graduates with the knowledge and skills base necessary to pursue a range of general business and management careers, as well as to undertake research in economics and related areas.

duration.text: The Industrial Economics at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
